cases.name: quoted_newlines_and_blank_record
cases.rationale: CSV logical records differ from physical lines; a blank CSV record is not a two-empty-cell row.

cases.name: exact_duplicate_and_blank_headers
cases.rationale: Empty header and empty cell positions remain distinct and positional.

cases.name: extra_fields_do_not_expand_baseline
cases.rationale: Confirmed contract: report extra width but do not invent additional baseline columns.

cases.name: empty_without_header
cases.rationale: Empty document has zero records and no inferred columns.

cases.name: unterminated_quote
cases.rationale: Strict dialect parser must refuse an unterminated quoted field.

cases.name: nul_input
cases.rationale: NUL is outside the declared CSV string contract.

cases.name: duplicate_same_value_key
cases.rationale: Raw duplicate names must be refused.

cases.name: trailing_garbage
cases.rationale: A valid prefix is not a valid complete document.

cases.name: invalid_utf8
cases.rationale: Invalid UTF-8 must produce the declared refusal, not a traceback.

cases.name: wire_byte_limit
cases.rationale: Leading whitespace still counts toward the declared input byte limit.

cases.name: header_true_requires_a_record
cases.rationale: Header=true requires an actual nonempty CSV record; this additional semantic precondition is not a structural JSON Schema constraint.

cases.name: header_true_requires_a_nonempty_record
cases.rationale: Header=true requires an actual nonempty CSV record; this additional semantic precondition is not a structural JSON Schema constraint.
